buyer_claim: The Canon EOS R5 I received has significant issues not disclosed in the listing. The autofocus hunts in low light, the burst rate drops to 8fps instead of the stated 20fps, and there's a faint banding pattern visible in images above ISO 6400. These are measurable performance defects that make this camera unsuitable for the professional wildlife photography I purchased it for.
seller_response: I thoroughly tested this camera before listing it and it performed within Canon specifications. The buyer is comparing it to a brand-new unit when this is a used camera. Autofocus performance varies with lens and conditions. I have pre-shipping test results showing the camera meeting all stated specifications.
